title: Raster renderer fills open stroked paths white when the path's size is derived (no explicit integer width/height)
steps: vixl new 400x200 -o w.vixl --background '#3355aa'; apply {type:shape, shape:path, path:'M 0 0 Q 100 200 200 0', stroke:'#cc0000', stroke_width:6, x:100, y:50} (no width/height, or width:200 only); vixl export w.png
expected: An open path with a stroke and no fill stays unfilled (CLAUDE.md: geometry.OPEN_SHAPES/default_fill, 'in every renderer'). PDF, SVG and PPTX leave it unfilled.
actual: PNG/render show a white-filled region inside the curve. The same op with integer width:200,height:100 renders correctly. Root cause: design_render.shape_image sends any non-int width/height (auto-derived 200.0) to vector_strokes.render, whose primitives use layer.get('fill','white') (vector_strokes.py:415, also :320) instead of geometry.default_fill(layer). The same route also covers dashed/width-profile/marker/catalog strokes, so those open paths are probably affected too. Independently re-confirmed by the lead tester (lead/openpath_*.png): a path with no size or a fractional size is filled white; width=200,height=100 renders correctly. Root cause: vector_strokes.py uses layer.get("fill","white") instead of geometry.default_fill.
evidence: out/stroke_clip_compare.png; repro/v.png; repro/v_pdf.png; repro/v_svg.png; out/pages/p1.png; out/pages/r_p1_pdf.png; ../lead/openpath_None.png

actual: Each layer is a nested <svg width/height viewBox> with no overflow='visible', so the default overflow:hidden clips it. Ink bbox is 100,50-299,149, which cuts off the end caps and the bottom miter. Vixl's own editable SVG import then rejects this file ('Clipped nested SVG strokes require svg_mode=appearance').

title: Overlap check is far slower than the CHANGELOG's '<1 s at 4,000 layers' claim; it is pathological when text layers overlap
steps: 4,000 text layers on a 4000x4000 canvas, dense grid (labels slightly overlap neighbours): Project.check(checks=['overlap']). Variants: 1,000 labels; 4,000 non-overlapping labels; 4,096 mixed layers (256 text).
expected: Under 1 s at 4,000 layers (CHANGELOG 0.22, #263).
actual: Overlapping labels: 252.8 s and 244.1 s at 4,000 layers (3.6 s / 9.4 s / 22.5 s at 250/500/1,000, so it grows superlinearly). Non-overlapping text: 6.0 s and 6.2 s. Mixed 4,096 doc: 2.4-3.0 s. 4,000 shapes only: 0.69 s. In the profile, checks.alpha -> render.layer_canvas_surface builds a full-canvas RGBA image (Image.new + getchannel) for every candidate text layer, which is 21 of 23.7 s at 1,000 layers. Timings were taken with a test suite running in the background, but the gap is 6x to 250x. (Lead review: downgraded from high to medium. The CHANGELOG figure holds for 4,000 shapes, measured at 0.7 s; the slowdown is specific to many overlapping text layers.)

title: Every apply costs O(layers), so a batch costs O(ops x layers): a documented 10,000-op batch takes about 6 minutes
steps: Python API: 2,000 shape adds plus 8,000 move ops in one apply (detail='brief'). Also a single move on a 4,096-layer doc, and a scaling sweep of 100/400 moves across 10/500/2,000/4,000 layers.
expected: A batch within the documented 10,000-op limit should finish in seconds, and one edit on a big doc should not take seconds.
actual: 10,000 ops: 364 s (dry_run 360 s; the same batch with a bad last op ran 394 s before it was rejected). The same 10,000 ops on a 10-layer doc: 3.9 s. One move on a 4,096-layer doc: 4.0-4.5 s (repeated 4x). Sweep: about 23 ms per op at 4,000 layers vs 0.5 ms at 10 layers. In the profile, apply() runs inspect() twice (8.3 of 10.3 s), and render.resolved_layers/solve run once per op. forms.has_fields scans every layer for each text layer through document_variables (9.5M genexpr calls for one move), which makes text measurement O(N^2). The CHANGELOG says this rescan was removed. Over MCP, any such batch will go to a background job.

title: lyric-video plan and export with sections, cue, repeat and break

title: Linux pip install: every update command fails with exit 1 and points to a Windows installer

expected: Replay returns the first result; a conflict is an error; history has one new revision.
actual: Replay took 22 ms and returned the recorded result; different args gave request_id_conflict; history showed exactly one revision. A failed call's id is not remembered (as documented). A retry with the same id while the job runs returns the same job id with progress.

title: as_job and automatic jobs

title: Workspace confinement over MCP and REST
steps: ../, absolute paths, symlinked file and directory pointing outside, symlink to /etc/passwd as operations_path, document=../x, icc_profile=/etc/passwd, check sample=/etc/passwd, font file paths in ops, link op outside, export to /tmp, ../ and symlink dir, export over .vixl and over a symlink.
expected: All refused with forbidden; nothing is created outside the workspace.
actual: All 30+ probes were refused ('Path is outside the workspace', with no absolute paths in the errors); no files were created outside. Filesystem fields in operations are refused. vixl_workspace_list hides symlinks.

title: URL imports refuse private targets in every encoding; redirects re-checked
steps: image/font URL import (MCP and REST /assets) to file://, http://, 127.0.0.1, [::1], 2130706433, 0x7f000001, 127.1, 017700000001, [::ffff:127.0.0.1], 0.0.0.0, 169.254.169.254, localtest.me, 127.0.0.1.nip.io, credentials in the URL; a loopback TCP listener on :18443; offline redirect harness (public → 127.0.0.1 / 169.254 / http / mapped IPv6 / mixed-DNS host / loop).
expected: All refused; the listener sees no connections.
actual: All refused with unsafe_url naming the resolved address; the listener logged 0 connections. Every redirect hop is re-validated, http downgrade is refused, more than 5 redirects fails, and a host with any private A record is refused. Real external fetches could not be tested because the sandbox egress proxy returns 403.

title: Malicious .vixl archives
steps: Crafted .vixl with a ../../ zip member, an image layer 'linked' to /etc/passwd, and asset '../../../../etc/passwd'.
expected: Refused or neutralized.
actual: zip-slip → invalid_project 'Unsafe or unsupported archive member'; linked → linked_asset_disabled at render/export; traversal asset → missing_asset. Nothing was written outside.

title: vixl serve endpoints, bind, auth, CORS
steps: Started on 127.0.0.1 (free port); exercised 30+ of 46 routes from /openapi.json.
expected: Loopback default, host and origin checks, documented routes working.
actual: Default bind 127.0.0.1 (docs: 8765). No auth by default on loopback, with Host-header validation (evil Host → 400). Every request with a foreign or null Origin is refused 403 cross_origin_forbidden (also text/plain and form 'simple' POSTs), and no Access-Control-* headers are sent. Token mode works. /compose is dry-run only (path/exports → 403). /preview, /compare, /render, /export (bytes, PSD), /check, /assets bytes and URL, and the SVG XXE and external-image rejection all work. The 10,001-op batch → resource_limit. Latency: GET /document 26-100 ms, /render 236 ms, /check 549 ms, /compose 1.1 s.

title: Export refuses to overwrite without overwrite=true
